review.intent_summary: Short histories yield observations, changes, and departure candidates with explicit comparison populations and limits.

criteria.criterion: The first observation records a value, the second records a change, and later departures from the prior range can be candidates.
Descriptive assessments use preceding observations and remain unchanged when future samples are appended.
Missing values break the comparison history, and zero previous values do not create relative-change evidence.
Early candidates remain non-triggering and ineligible for action even under a permissive policy.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent inspected every declared implementation reference and compared acceptance criteria with current source and test assertions; this is a fresh semantic review, completed in the existing session.
Read candidate comparison population, early maturity, established/not_established text and MCP candidate tests; candidates have criterion_met false and never authorize action.
